description_en: Performs a paged query for EIAM organizational units
name: ListOrganizationalUnits

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 列表大小，默认20，最大不超过100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The list of organizational unit IDs. The number of IDs in the list cannot exceed 100
parameters.help_zh: 组织ID列表，列表元素数量最多不超过100
parameters.name: organizational_unit_ids

parameters.help_en: The name of the organizational unit. An exact match is used for the query
parameters.help_zh: 组织名称，查询为精确匹配查询
parameters.name: organizational_unit_name

parameters.help_en: The prefix of the name of the organizational unit. A left-side match is used for the query
parameters.help_zh: 组织名称前缀，查询为左匹配查询
parameters.name: organizational_unit_name_starts_with

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent organizational unit
parameters.name: parent_id

items.description_en: The data object of the organizational unit

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the organizational unit was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 组织创建时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒

Description.description_en: The description of the organizational unit

Leaf.description_en: Indicates whether the organizational unit is a leaf node. A value of true indicates that the organizational unit has no child nodes. A value of false indicates that the organizational unit has child nodes
Leaf.description_zh: 是否叶子节点，true表示该组织没有子节点，false表示该组织下存在子节点

OrganizationalUnitExternalId.description_en:
The external ID of the organizational unit. This ID is used to map the data of the organizational unit to the data of an external system. By default, the value of this parameter is the organizational unit ID.

Note: The external ID must be unique within the same source type and source ID
OrganizationalUnitExternalId.description_zh:
组织外部ID，用于外部数据与IDaaS组织的数据关联映射，默认为IDaaS组织ID。

说明：外部ID在同一来源类型和来源ID下唯一

OrganizationalUnitName.description_en: The name of the organizational unit

OrganizationalUnitSourceId.description_en: The source ID of the organizational unit

OrganizationalUnitSourceType.description_en:
The source type of the organizational unit. Valid values:

build_in: The organizational unit is created in IDaaS.
ding_talk: The organizational unit is imported from DingTalk.
ad: The organizational unit is imported from Active Directory (AD).
ldap: The organizational unit is imported from a Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) directory.
we_com: The organizational unit is imported from WeCom
OrganizationalUnitSourceType.description_zh:
组织来源类型，取值可选范围：
build_in：自建。
ding_talk：钉钉导入。
ad：AD导入。
ldap：LDAP导入。
we_com：企业微信导入

ParentId.description_en: The ID of the parent organizational unit

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the organizational unit was last updated. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
UpdateTime.description_zh: 组织最近一次更新时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries that are returned. This value is the total number of matched entries. The maximum number of entries that can be returned in a single request is specified by PageSize
TotalCount.description_zh: 数据总条数目，为匹配到的总数量，单次返回最大数量以pageSize为准
